messages:
anya: Quick ping — I have a docs PR that needs to land before the next release branch cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :link:
liz: which cutoff are we aligning to?
mike: the release notes said feature flag 'beta-ui' goes out with v2.0, right? if that ships we should have the migration guide in /v2.0 docs.
anya: correct — cut is Tue 2026-03-31 18:00 UTC. I need the PR merged by 2026-03-31 15:00 UTC to allow the docs CI preview and a last-minute spellcheck pass.
sam: what does CI say? I can grab the preview and smoke test.
docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4321 — link-check: failed (2 broken anchors), lint: warn.
anya: thanks bot. The two broken anchors are from the SDK snippet section — I updated the id but forgot to update the links. small fix, pushing now.
liz: also FYI the SDK snippet needs the new client constructor shape, otherwise devs will get runtime error. Example should be:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2' })
await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-2', prompt: 'hi' })
```
mike: thanks for including that. One ask: can we keep the old snippet as a compatibility note with a short blurb? lots of customers still on legacy client.
anya: yes — adding a short migration note under "SDK changes". I'll update now and push.
sam: I'm free to review at 14:00 UTC and can run the smoke checklist: load quickstart, run snippet, check /v2.0 nav.
liz: I'll give LGTM after the preview shows the anchor fixes and the migration note.
docs-ci-bot: New preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4321 — link-check: pass, lint: warn.
anya: perfect. @liz @mike @sam — can we aim to merge at 14:30 UTC so I can queue the docs publish job before cut? trying to avoid post-cut merges.
mike: 14:30 works for me, I'll be on the merge and will watch the release-bot for conflicts.
liz: +1.
sam: +1, will run the quick smoke at 14:10 then sign off.
release-bot: Heads-up — release branch cut scheduled 2026-03-31 18:00 UTC. Any PRs merged after 2026-03-31 18:00 UTC will target main and require backport.
anya: noted, thanks release-bot.
anya: one more note — this PR touches a versioned path (/v2.0/migration). please don't squash history (we need the two separate commits for revertability).
mike: understood. I'll merge with merge-commit.
liz: can we add a tiny test to the docs CI to assert the nav presence for /v2.0? follow-up ticket created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/211.
anya: thanks all — will keep thread updated if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
